title.zh: Brown University Health 临床与运营智能体三层架构（LIVE17 实录）
title.en: Brown University Health Three-Tier Clinical & Operational AI Architecture (LIVE17)

label.zh: 1. 分层构建与临床冠军赋能层（Grassroots & Top-Down Enablement）
2. AI 卓越中心风险分级与全域治理层（Risk-Based CoE & Purview / Agent 365）
label.en: 2. AI Center of Excellence Risk Gate & Observability Plane

label.zh: 3. 床旁电子病历与办公双轨触达层（Point-of-Care EHR & Knowledge Endpoints）
全员安全基座：Copilot Chat

detail.zh: 面向约 20,000 名员工开放受保护健康信息（PHI）隔离对话，约 8,000 人活跃使用
detail.en: PHI-protected LLM access across ~20,000 employees with ~8,000 active users

label.zh: 临床构建者沙盒：Copilot Studio

detail.zh: 赋能 189 名一线医生与先锋自建 1,045 个智能体（如神经外科术前与医保预授权代理）
detail.en: 189 clinician & SME builders prototyping 1,045 agents in a governed sandbox

label.zh: 科研飞地与本地知识：Foundry + Work IQ

detail.zh: 科研团队调用 Microsoft Foundry，临床代理严格锁死院内 SharePoint/Teams 指南禁公网
detail.en: Foundry for research teams; agents restricted to curated SharePoint/Teams sources

label.zh: AI 卓越中心（AI CoE）双向孵化

detail.zh: 实时透视沙盒高价值原型主动帮扶扩规模，或承接一线构建者的生产晋升申请
detail.en: CoE spots high-value sandbox prototypes proactively or accepts builder scale requests

label.zh: 临床风险分级验证与审批门禁

detail.zh: 触及患者诊疗决策划为高风险执行严苛临床核验；行政入职等低风险走敏捷通道
detail.en: High-risk clinical care agents undergo strict validation; admin flows move faster

label.zh: Agent 365 实名登记与 Purview 审计

detail.zh: 强制绑定责任人、用途与运行花名册，全量留存交互提示词日志与异常遥测
detail.en: Mandatory owner registration, runtime session tracking & full Purview audit trails

label.zh: 诊室床旁窗口：Dragon Copilot + EHR
label.en: Point of Care: Dragon Copilot in EHR

detail.zh: 在环境语音病历录入同屏直接挂载 Copilot Studio 专科指南与核查智能体
detail.en: Ambient documentation window embeds Copilot Studio agents directly inside Epic EHR

label.zh: 行政与协同端点：Copilot App & Teams

detail.zh: 面向行政、排班与新聘医师入职（Provider Onboarding）自动化减负提速
detail.en: Streamlines knowledge worker tasks and automates new provider onboarding steps

label.zh: 医疗三大核心挑战闭环成效

detail.zh: 缓解财务拒付压力（编码追问 43→13/百台）、缩短患者候诊周期、降低医生职业倦怠
detail.en: Eases financial pressure (43→13 coding queries), expands patient access & cuts burnout

label.zh: 进阶为构建者
受控沙盒可见
受控院内信源
双向提报扩规模
高风险审批入床旁
敏捷发布至办公端
释放临床时间
持续日志与审计
